hooks.name: Git status on session start
hooks.description: Shows the repo, branch and whether there are uncommitted changes when a Claude Code session starts.

hooks.name: Finished working
hooks.description: A banner that slides away when Claude finishes. Click it to jump to that session's terminal tab.

hooks.name: Input needed
hooks.description: A panel that stays on screen while Claude is waiting on you. Click it to jump to that session's terminal tab.

pending.title: Control Terminal
